annotations.title: Pre-release check for an MCP server

description: Returns, signed, what public change logs will record when an MCP server ships a new tool list. It lists tools added or removed, descriptions rewritten, schemas widened, annotation escalations, and whether the version moved. Use before releasing your own server: give its registry name or endpoint, the new tools and version. It calls no tool on it. To check another server use mcp_servers.

endpoint.description: Remote MCP endpoint URL, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp

server_name.description: Name in the MCP Registry, e.g. io.github.owner/server

tools.description: The new tools/list tools array; omit to read the endpoint live

name: mcp_precheck
title: Pre-release check for an MCP server
